customerOutcome: Establish an account through only the configured original authentication methods, preserving password-manager/paste support and non-secret input after refusal.
entryConditions: No current authenticated session; existing original auth owner decides registration and enterprise SSO availability
The registered experience locale uses EN/DA; display language grants no identity or company authority
exitConditions: Only a current Native session can continue; email verification remains required where configured
Original permitted next/invite route or SaaS welcome continues into the existing company onboarding owner; no auth transport can fabricate verification

content.supportingCopy: Use the configured account method to continue to company setup.
displayedState: Current configured email and enterprise SSO options only
A Native verification-email receipt when the original account owner requires verification
Localized pending/refusal/retry information without provider error bodies

inputs.label: Name
inputs.default: Empty or the current unsent in-memory input
inputs.help: Required by the original account profile during email registration

inputs.label: Email
inputs.default: Empty or the current unsent in-memory input
inputs.help: Account identifier and configured organization SSO lookup

inputs.label: Password
inputs.default: Empty or the current unsent in-memory input
inputs.help: Email authentication only; no related profile questions
inputs.validation: Original configured minimum length and authentication owner; never logged
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Native current-password/new-password autocomplete; password managers and paste allowed

primary.label: Continue
primary.operation: Explicit registration through original sign-up/email; original Sign In or company SSO uses the corresponding configured authentication owner

secondary: Switch between email sign-in and registration when original signup is available
Use the original reset-password route where configured
Choose EN or DA without submitting credentials

canonicalReadDomains: Original auth get-session and public SaaS capabilities
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original email registration/sign-in or configured company SSO only; no V9 identity store, synthetic verification, organization provisioning or password persistence
systemWork.authorityEffect: Native auth and current membership remain authoritative. Public capability visibility and display locale confer no permissions.
systemWork.asyncWork: Original explicit auth request, guarded safe next/invite path, original verification-mail owner and current session/company-cache reconciliation
systemWork.receipt: Original current auth session or actual configured verification receipt; no inferred first value

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Preserve entered non-secret in-memory values until leaving the page
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No password or account-field persistence in browser storage
navigation.resume: Original current-session and verification owners decide the next admissible setup step

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Public configured account capabilities, current form inputs and localized fixed refusal reasons
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Do not retain credentials in V9 browser storage, HTTP logs or raw error bodies; the existing auth owner handles account records and verification.

functional: Verify canonical state, version conflicts, safe replay, unavailable states and principal/company switching on the exact artifact.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
